en.masjidLog.tahiyyatBody: On entering the masjid, the Sunnah is to pray two rakahs before sitting down: tahiyyat al-masjid, the greeting of the masjid.
en.masjidLog.tahiyyatNextIqamah: Next iqamah at your masjid: {{prayer}} at {{time}}. Arriving a few minutes early leaves time for these two rakahs.
en.tour.steps.masjids.title: Masjids near you
en.tour.steps.masjids.body: Find nearby masjids from OpenStreetMap, set your home masjid, and keep your own iqamah times, typed in or read from a photo of the timetable.
en.fiqh.diff.masjid.tahiyyat.title: Tahiyyat al-masjid in the disliked times and during the khutbah
en.fiqh.diff.masjid.tahiyyat.notDislikedTim: Sunnah, but not prayed in the times when voluntary Salah is disliked (after Fajr and Asr, at sunrise, zenith and sunset), nor once the imam has begun the Friday khutbah.
en.fiqh.diff.masjid.tahiyyat.shafii: Sunnah, and prayed even in the disliked times because it has a cause (entering the masjid). During the Friday khutbah, two short rakahs are prayed.
en.fiqh.diff.masjid.tahiyyat.hanbali: Sunnah. The relied-on view is not to pray it in the disliked times (another report from Imam Ahmad allows it); during the Friday khutbah, two short rakahs are prayed.
